notes: Neither seeded fixture ships tests, so 'untested new logic' findings (medium, severity.md fixed rule 1) are expected and REAL. Label them real when they appear under 'unexpected'.

defects.summary: applyDiscount treats a 0-100 percentage as a 0-1 fraction; 15% off produces a negative total
paginate returns pageSize + 1 items; the last item of each page repeats as the first of the next
checkout uses forEach(async): reservations are not awaited, failures become unhandled rejections, and ok:true is returned before stock is reserved
formatTotal reimplements the existing formatCurrency utility in src/utils/money.ts (and mishandles negative amounts)
legacyTotal is unexported and unused dead code (and ignores quantity)
